screenshots.name: admin-fhir-supply-delivery
screenshots.description: SupplyDelivery resource structure showing receipt and transfer fields - a FHIR resource detail view or JSON representation displaying the SupplyDelivery resource with its key properties: identifier (receipt-number, invoice-number), status lifecycle (in-progress, completed, abandoned), supplier reference, meta.tag, and extensions for document-type (receipt vs transfer), source-department, destination-department, item fields (code, name, type, quantity, price, total, unit, expiration, series)

captureSteps.script: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr'); return 'table rows found: ' + rows.length; })()

(() => { const links = document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr td a'); if (links.length > 0) { return 'first receipt link: ' + links[0].textContent.trim().substring(0, 40); } return 'no receipt links found'; })()

(() => { const heading = document.querySelector('h1, h2, [class*="title"], [class*="header"]'); return heading ? 'page heading: ' + heading.textContent.trim().substring(0, 60) : 'no heading found'; })()

alternativeCaptureSteps.description: If direct FHIR resource viewer is not accessible, capture the SupplyDelivery detail from the reception detail/edit page which shows the resource fields in a form layout

steps.script: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr'); if (rows.length > 0) rows[0].click(); return 'clicked first row'; })()

alternativeCaptureSteps.description: If no test data exists, capture the resource structure from the documentation site code block or Mermaid diagram illustrating the SupplyDelivery resource

steps.script: (() => { const el = document.getElementById('fhir-receipt'); if (el) { el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'instant', block: 'start' }); return 'scrolled to fhir-receipt'; } return 'anchor not found'; })()

mustContain: SupplyDelivery resource fields or detail view showing receipt/transfer structure
